views.note: The bumper step, wheel centres and two door creases line up in the three-quarter view. The outer shoulder of the bumper looks squarer in the model.

views.label: Chicago show car · front bumper
views.note: The show car exposes the stepped upper grille, two fog pockets and thin red splitter edge. The corner blade and unplated nose are visible in both views.

views.label: Chicago show car · 20-inch wheel and brake
views.note: Five paired black spokes surround the red Honda centre cap. The red line sits on the outer flange, and the red front caliper sits behind the spokes.

views.note: The wheel centres establish the wheelbase. The side profile shows the pressed-in lower door crease turning towards the rear wheel.

views.label: Factory photograph · rear right from above
views.credit: American Honda Motor Co. · 2020 U.S. press kit
views.note: The roof extension, wing feet and rising sill are visible together. The black hatch bridge and the depth of the rear bumper are approximate.

views.label: Factory photograph · front elevation
views.credit: American Honda Motor Co. · 2020 U.S. press kit
views.note: The badge and both fog lamps locate the main grille. The horizontal wing across the headlamps is wider at the outer corners in the model.

views.label: Factory photograph · rear elevation
views.credit: American Honda Motor Co. · 2020 U.S. press kit
views.note: The tips sit centrally beneath the diffuser, with a smaller middle bore. The Chicago display plate appears on the model.

views.label: Chicago show car · passenger side
views.note: The passenger-side sill rises ahead of the rear wheel and the fender outlet ends just ahead of the front door. Reflections emphasize the crease in the photograph.

views.label: Chicago show car · headlamp and bumper
views.note: The stepped black brow runs into the grille. The side marker, headlamp and fog pocket are present. The model’s bumper shoulder remains more upright.

views.label: Chicago show car · fog lamp and corner slots
views.note: Three corner slots sit outside the fog pocket. The blue blade rises at its outer end, above the round fog lamp. The pocket’s depth is approximate.

views.label: Honda catalogue · low front three-quarter
views.note: The Japanese car shares the FK8 body and wheel package. Its front plate, clear side markers and right-hand-drive cabin differ from the U.S. car. The low hood angle is approximate.
views.configuration: Japanese-market FK8. Front plate and clear side markers differ.

views.label: Rear, straight on
views.note: The two separate C-shaped lamps frame the black hatch bridge. The model wears the white display plate photographed in Chicago.

views.label: Wing, rear glass and right lamp
views.note: The hatch carries the wing and its two blue endplates. The close-up reveals differences in the outer sail profile and the width of the lower glass crosspiece.

views.label: Hatch, bumper and diffuser
views.note: The white Honda show plate occupies the same recess as the auction car’s empty plate frame. The two outer exhaust tips flank the smaller central tip.

views.label: Left bumper insert and blue blade
views.note: The body-coloured blade wraps around the black mesh in the corner of the facelift bumper. A narrow red reflector follows its outer edge.

views.label: Three centre exhaust tips
views.note: The three open tailpipes sit in the middle of the diffuser. Their centre-to-centre spacing and the smaller middle outlet are visible in both images.

views.label: Left C-shaped taillight
views.note: The lens wraps around the clear reflector. The model has ruby ribs and silver and amber reflector cells. Its internal optics are simplified.

views.label: Wing blade and left support
views.note: The black wing rises above the upper hatch glass. The curvature at the mounting saddles and the wiper profile remain approximate.

views.label: Driver’s side profile
views.note: The two wheel centres and rocker locate the driver’s side. The paired-spoke rims and the lower door crease follow the facelift car.

views.label: Passenger side profile
views.note: The passenger-side photograph shows the lower door pressing and side-skirt kick-up ahead of the rear tire.

views.label: Front left three-quarter
views.note: The fog pocket and side marker turn around the front corner, ahead of the wheel. The bumper and hood creases remain softer in the photograph.

views.label: Front, straight on
views.note: The swept headlights meet the black upper grille. The tow-side plate bracket in this auction photograph belonged to the photographed car.

views.label: Closed hood and intake scoop
views.note: The elevated view shows the open hood duct and folded hood edges. The U.S. show car in the model uses an unplated nose.

views.label: 20-inch wheel and Brembo brake
views.note: The wheel opening follows the tire shoulder. The photographic highlights trace five pairs of black spokes and a fine red line around the flange.

views.label: Open rear hatch and doors
views.note: The hatch lifts with the rear wing and the two inner lamp tips. The cargo trim and the visible rear-seat backs are simplified.

views.label: Painted wing endplate
views.note: The driver-side blue wing sail extends back over the lamp. The curvature and the transition into the mounting foot are approximate.

views.label: Wing foot from the side
views.note: The stepped lower edge and the black saddle appear from the passenger side. This close view leaves uncertainty in the inboard buttress.

views.label: Upper glass, wiper and black crosspiece
views.note: The wing spans the split hatch glass and the wiper sits just above the lower black crosspiece.

views.label: Roof-edge vortex generators
views.note: The antenna sits ahead of the individually molded vortex generators along the hatch roof edge.

views.label: Right lamp and Type R badge
views.note: The red C and its inboard hatch segment surround a silver and amber reflector. The individual reflector facets and optical depth are approximate.

views.label: Right bumper insert
views.note: The red reflector is outboard of the painted blade. Their positions can be compared here, while the depth and slope of the molded recess remain approximate.

views.label: Side of the diffuser
views.note: The vertical reflector and the blade sit above the red diffuser lip. The model approximates the inboard corner of the vent and the underbody.

views.label: Rear wheel arch and quarter panel
views.note: The rear wheel, arch opening, rising sill and door shutline share this passenger-side frame.

views.label: Front fog light and bumper blade
views.note: The circular passenger-side lamp sits beneath the angled insert. The auction car carries a front-plate bracket.

views.label: Bonnet and forward-facing scoop
views.note: The elevated camera shows the intake lip, the hood edges and the passenger-side headlamp in one frame.

views.label: Door seams and side skirt
views.note: The front door handle, B-pillar, and lower sill locate the crease running through both left doors.

views.label: Passenger-side mirror housing
views.note: The passenger-side mirror shows the blue cap, black lower shell and short stalk. The narrow lens follows the outer edge.

views.label: Driver’s seat and bolsters
views.note: Two harness openings pierce the red front backrest. The black bolsters and integrated head restraint follow the Honda seat detail. The lower cushion and seat rails are approximate.

views.label: Dashboard from the passenger side
views.note: The display, climate panel and manual shifter are in the U.S. left-hand-drive layout. Their surfaces and switchgear are approximate.

views.label: Steering wheel and instrument panel
views.note: The red centre badge sits inside the driver’s wheel. The switch pods, spoke profiles and dashboard trim are simplified.

views.label: Centre vents and display
views.note: The upper vents, screen and climate dials locate the central stack. The controls, display graphics and brushed trim are simplified.

views.label: Aluminium shifter and console
views.note: The manual lever rises from its boot on the raised centre console. The switch graphics and individual production plaque vary by car.

views.label: Type R console plaque
views.note: This auction car carries a vehicle-specific numbered plaque. The photograph records its lettering and console location.

views.label: Rear seats
views.note: The rear bench and central cupholders sit behind the front buckets. The belt routing, cushion profile and open-door camera are approximate.

views.label: Luggage compartment
views.note: The open hatch exposes the load floor between the two side walls. The model simplifies the carpet, side recesses and latch.

views.label: Open hood and K20C1 engine bay
views.note: The red K20C1 cover and the intake identify the engine layout. The hoses, supports and underhood trim are simplified.

views.label: Red Honda valve cover
views.note: The red Honda cover is visible beneath the open hood. The cap, fasteners, hoses and surrounding brackets are approximate.

views.label: Front undertray
views.note: The auction car is raised on a lift. The photograph records the undertray and fasteners, which are simplified in the model.

views.label: Exhaust and diffuser from below
views.note: The centre exhaust has a smaller bore than the outer pair. The carbon-pattern diffuser and thin red lip sit above the tips.

views.label: Honda Japan · front Brembo brake detail
views.note: Honda’s moving-wheel close-up shows the red Brembo casting, factory wheel pinstripe and the brake disc through the spokes. The Japanese car is white.

views.label: Honda Japan · Type R seat upholstery
views.note: The right-hand-drive cabin photograph shows the shoulder openings, red upholstery, black bolsters and embroidery shared with the U.S. seats.
